about: Questions for "Ask my AI" (task 3.2.3), graded by code, not by a model. `expect`: every group must match (any one string in a group, ignoring case). `cite`: the answer cites at least one source. `unknown`: the documents don't say, so the answer must say "I don't know". `forbid`: patterns that must not appear. Every answer is also checked for length and for anything shaped like a phone number. Expected facts come from src/content/resume.json.
